name: Placeholder image resolve

source.description: 2 inspected reference films (batch-3, batch-7, 2026-11-26): a light AI image demo shows a grey placeholder with a sheen, then scattered patches of the final image spreading until it resolves.

technique: A grey placeholder box appears where an image will be, a faint sheen passes over it, then scattered patches of the final image show through and spread until the image resolves. Generation or loading is shown as a process, so the result feels earned.
purpose: Show generation or loading as a process, so the result feels earned.
visual_behaviour: A grey rounded placeholder appears where the image will be and a faint sheen passes over it; patches of the final image show through at scattered points and spread until the whole image is there.
mechanics: Placeholder: a rounded rectangle in the canvas tone with a diagonal sheen sweeping across over about 1.0 s (ref-ad023ce9dc 10.88-12.0 s). Resolve: mask the final image with a seeded set of blobs whose radii grow from 0 to full cover over 1.0-1.2 s (power1.in), starting at 12.0 s and complete at about 13.1 s. Blob centres from a seeded PRNG so every render matches.

decomposition.timing: Sheen about 1 s; resolve 1.0-1.2 s; about 2.2 s in all.

parameters.name: resolve_duration
parameters.description: Seconds from first patch to full image

use_cases: Explaining AI image generation or rendering
A result that develops like a photograph
failure_modes: Unseeded random patches break deterministic renders
Too fast and it reads as a glitch, not a process

implementation.approach: Placeholder: a rounded rectangle in the canvas tone with a diagonal gradient sheen swept across in about 1 s. Resolve: an SVG mask of seeded circles whose radii grow from 0 to full cover over 1.0-1.2 s (power1.in); centres from the Studio PRNG, never Math.random. Not built as a component.

provenance.observed: A grey placeholder in a chat panel gets scattered warm patches (12.0-12.6 s) that spread until the photo resolves at 13.1 s.
A grey listing card resolves into a full product listing as a vertical light bar sweeps across it (8.0-9.0 s), accents at 8.01 and 8.96 s.
